_comment: Every global gameplay number. Source: design doc 'Starting numbers' tab (2026-10-22) unless marked 'placeholder'. All first drafts: tune in playtests.

paths._xp_per_use: placeholder: 60,500 XP per path ~ 80 h at 1x

resources._all: placeholder: doc defines behaviour only (Heat builds, boosts damage, stops at full; Chill fills slowly, spending it all makes bigger shatters)

nodeEffects._comment: Per-rank effect of each stat node (path.node -> stat -> amount per rank). Placeholders; ability nodes are separate abilities.

fx._comment: Combat feel and effect budgets (WRFx; the effects themselves are recipes in Data/fx.json). Client-side only. hitStop: how long both fighters' animation freezes on heavy blows (heavy swings, weapon arts, crits, ripostes, shatters, guard breaks) and parries, seconds. shake.<moment>: camera trauma 0..1 added (radius > 0: fades with distance from the camera, for slams and spells), scale = master (0 turns shaking off), maxAngle degrees / maxOffset cm at full trauma, decay per second, frequency of the wobble. impact.heavyScale = how much bigger a heavy blow's sparks/blood are, elementScale = the fire/frost burst on an infused or path melee hit. hud: hit marker and parry flash (seconds, alpha). Budgets: sprites per batch, pooled lights, distances (cm) for one-shots, drawing and lights. ambient/lava/weather: fires on Hearths and torches, statuses, lava embers, snow and ash (ridge distances from x = 0, cm).

hazards._comment: Biome gear checks: lava river (needs lava resistance), slick ice (needs ice resistance).

sky._comment: How the clock looks (WRSky): sun height at noon and depth at midnight (degrees), the moon's light (lux; the map's sun is ~10) and how far above the opposite of the sun it rides, the sky light at night (x the map's), and the dimmest auto-exposure may go (EV100: higher = darker nights). placeholder
sky._air: The air by biome (polish pass): the camera's side of the ridge (X; blend biomeWidth cm wide around biomeCentre) picks haze colour (sRGB) and density, the grade (white balance K: higher = warmer, saturation, gain r,g,b) and blends across. nightFogColor is linear. A low sun (below goldenHourBelow degrees) adds light shafts (bloom, threshold, occlusion darkness, tint) and a warm glow in the fog toward it. The valley mist is a local fog volume in each hollow of Data/valley_fog.json (node Tools/terrain/valleys.mjs), lifted mistLift cm, radius x mistRadiusScale: density mistDensity x (mistDay..mistNight by daylight, + mistDawn / mistDusk around dawn and dusk), height falloff (engine units: higher = thinner layer) and offset, albedo by side (sRGB). shadowLift (linear, x nightShadowLift at night) keeps blacks from crushing. volumetricFog 1 turns on volumetric fog (costs GPU).

sea._comment: The sea (WRSea, polish pass): the WaterMaterials ocean at level cm over the open sea of Data/sea_mask.json (node Tools/terrain/sea_mask.mjs), in squares one mask cell (4 m) wide at the shore growing to distance / falloff (bigger falloff = finer far out) up to maxSquare cm, out to extent cm across, split into tile cm meshes near the island (8x that further out); uvScale cm per texture repeat. dim: material parameters with their daytime values that dim to nightDim x at night (glow, foam glow, painted highlights, sky reflection). scalars / colours (sRGB) set any of the material's parameters by name.

water._comment: Swimming and drinking (UWRWaterSubsystem, feedback pass): a water volume over the open sea of Data/sea_mask.json from floor cm up to the drawn surface (sea.level + surfaceOffset: the sea's material draws its surface about that much above the mesh, measured from the beach waterline), out to extent cm from the middle (map: the map it's built on when the mask doesn't say). You swim while the capsule's middle is under the surface (the ground about a metre down): buoyancy (above 1 floats higher: at 1.6 the capsule's middle sits a quarter metre under the surface, the eyes 40 cm over it), swimSpeed cm/s; the body art rides swimLift cm higher on the capsule while swimming along (lying on the surface) and treadLift while treading water; friction the water's drag (what slows you when you stop swimming); braking cm/s2 stays 0 (the engine stops any slow speed dead under braking, so a body under the surface would never float up). E drinks in the water or at its edge (feet at most drinkReach cm above the surface, water at least drinkMinDepth cm deep within drinkRange cm in front): drinkThirst Water per gulp, one every drinkSeconds; seaDrinkable 0 makes the sea too salty. Creatures wade up to creatureWade x their half-height (checked creatureLookAhead cm past their radius) and turn back from deeper water. Swim sounds within soundRange cm, a stroke every strokeSeconds. The fall-through rescue (WRGameMode): a swimmer with the landscape more than rescueMargin cm over it is under the island and put back on top; the rescue traces down from rescueTraceTop cm, and holds anyone who falls below voidZ cm (under the sea floor) there until the ground over them has streamed in. placeholder

camera._comment: Third-person camera (WRCameraBoom, polish pass): the wall / tree probe radius cm; how fast the camera eases back out after something pulled it in (it always pulls in at once); degrees the view widens while sprinting and how fast; lock-on turns start at lockOnStartSpeed and firm up to lockOnSpeed over lockOnEaseSeconds.

bosses._comment: Shared boss rules, then per-boss overrides: bosses.<id>.<attack>.damage/windup/cooldown/range/size, bosses.<id>.health/arenaRadius/... (see WRBoss.cpp for every key).

ranged._comment: Bows, crossbows, blowguns, spears, bolas (weapon numbers are in items.json). Aiming camera arm cm / fov / walk speed x; hip-fire spread; throw release s; projectile radius cm, flight s, stuck s, stick depth cm; bola roots creatures up to this radius cm, else slows; poise per damage; grip cm from the wrist; durability per shot. placeholder

taming._comment: Knockout taming, ARK-style. Seconds above = seconds of eating plain food (what it eats); a knocked-out creature eats one item from its stash every secondsPerFood, kibble counts kibbleValue x. Torpor: max = health x torporPerHealth, drains per second (fraction of max) awake / unconscious; a narcotic adds narcoticTorpor of max. Effectiveness starts at 1, loses effectivenessPerHit per hit while it's out and effectivenessPerPlainMeal per non-kibble meal; the tame gets health and bite x (1 + effectiveness x bonusAtFull). Waking keeps wakeKeepsProgress of the progress. A tame told to stay only fights within stayGuardRadius cm of its post. placeholder

gathering._comment: The island's trees, rocks and shrubs (Data/island_dressing.json). perHit is before the tool's yield, the server gatherMultiplier and life skills (heavy hits x2); hits until it's used up; minutes until it grows back. placeholder

building._foundationSink: cm a new foundation sits into the ground at its centre, so its floor (100 up) is a walkable step. placeholder

flow._comment: The moments between play (WRUIFlow): the death screen and its fades; the Loading the island cover, held until World Partition has streamed streamRadius cm around you (at most streamMaxSeconds), shown after a jump of teleportCm or more; screens ease in over screenInSeconds; notices queue (each up noticeSeconds, at least noticeMinSeconds when others wait); banners, toasts and hints; discovery radii by place kind (cm); menuCamera is the main menu backdrop (cm, degrees). placeholder

inventory._comment: The bag: carrying more than carryKg (bag + worn + held) slows you to overweightSpeed; dropped items lie in a bag for dropMinutes. placeholder

wildlife._comment: Island wildlife sites (Data/island_spawns.json, from Tools/terrain/spawns.mjs): a pack comes out when a player is within activationRadius cm of its site and fades away after despawnSeconds with nobody within activationRadius x leaveRadiusMult (tamed and knocked-out creatures stay). enabled 0 turns the sites off. placeholder

world._comment: streamingRangeScale: how far the ground streams in around each player, times the map loading range (256 m); decorationDistanceScale: trees, rocks and cliffs drawn this many times further; undergroundMargin (cm): anyone this far under the island is put back on top (WRGameMode).

significance._comment: Wildlife cost by distance (UWRSignificanceSubsystem, Docs/PERFORMANCE.md): a creature further than farRadius cm from every remote player (they're sent creatures within 150 m) and localFarRadius cm from a player on the server's own machine (a listen-server host sees further) ticks its body, movement and brain every farTickInterval s, moving in steps of up to farMaxStep s, and replication looks at it farNetUpdateRate times a second; back to every frame inside the radius minus margin. Bosses and ridden creatures always run every frame. Each creature is looked at once every slices frames (a slice per frame, which also spreads their slow ticks over different frames). enabled 0 turns it off (comparisons).

preload._comment: Art loaded by path when something first appears (creatures, caves, bodies, held weapons) is loaded in the background at map start instead (UWRPreloadSubsystem, Data/preload.json). enabled 0 turns it off (comparisons).

clock._comment: World clock: real minutes per in-game day, the hour a new server starts at, night from duskHour to dawnHour, twilightHours of fade either side. placeholder

anim._comment: How bodies animate (UWRAnimInstance). Crossfade seconds between any two states (blendSeconds), into / out of a one-shot (shotBlendIn / shotBlendOut); idle blends into walking over idleToWalk x the walk's pace; locomotion play rates stay within minRate..maxRate of each clip's measured pace; the upper layer takes the legs too below legsMovingSpeed cm/s. Turn in place: standing, the legs stay put while the facing swings, up to turnMaxDegrees; past turnThreshold a turn clip steps them round; moving, they catch up at turnCatchUp deg/s. Footsteps play within footstepRange cm of a local player. Creatures: turn at creatureSpinRate deg/s standing and creatureTurnRate on the move; with creatureArcTurns on, AI movement leads its facing by at most creatureLeadDegrees (curves, not sideways slides) and, nearly stopped and facing more than creatureSpinAngle away, creeps at creatureSpinCreep x speed while it turns on the spot; feet step at creatureTurnStep x radius per radian turned on the spot; idle plays at sleepIdleRate asleep. Attack clips are timed so the strike lands with the damage: creatureAttack.<move>.rate fixes a move's pace (0 = fit), snap/lunge/charge .hit = when the damage lands after the swing / windup, within creatureAttackMinRate..MaxRate.

creatureAI._comment: Wild creature behaviour. Hunting: carnivores get hungry every huntIntervalMinutes (x0.75-1.25), hunt the nearest wild non-carnivore up to preySizeRatio x their own radius (pack hunters packPreySizeRatio), eat a kill for eatSeconds (every hunter on it within shareKillRadius shares it), retry huntRetrySeconds after prey gets away; prey notice a hunter within preyNoticeRadius and bolt in bursts (preyRestSeconds between runs); a hunter in pursuit runs at huntSpeedMult and follows prey up to huntLeash cm from home. Morale: flee below fleeHealth, or below packFleeHealth when a packmate died in the last packLossSeconds, for fleeSeconds at fleeSpeedMult. Sleep: aggro x sleepAggroMult asleep, x nightAggroMult for night hunters at night; a hit keeps it awake wokenSeconds. Attacks: min/max range cm, windup s (telegraphed), cooldown s, damageMult x its bite, poise, plus per-move numbers. placeholder

bite._bite: its snap at running prey (prey can't block or dodge; at survivors it swings its bite ability)
